issues.description: The problem statement requires storing the result in a variable named `score_counter`, but the solution declares `score_cnt` in the data section and the template does not declare any such variable. This naming mismatch will confuse students who follow the spec and look for `score_counter` in the starter code or solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the data label in the solution to `score_counter` (e.g. `score_counter dd 0`) and/or add the matching declaration to the template so the starter code matches the problem statement. Alternatively, update the problem statement to require `score_cnt` if that name is intentional.
